notes.title: Patch 1.0.2.1: Cyclord, Two-Handed Weapons and more!
notes.notes:
Hello Humans!

The millisecond after we sliced the ribbon on The Skyscrapper, we began obsessively reading your comments for things we could fix!!!

We love and appreciate all the glowing feedback and amazing fan art you’ve sent us. Check out some of our recent faves after the Patch Notes.

HOWEVER, we want Clone Drone in the Hyperdome to be the best. To be the best, you have to bash the bugs. So we grabbed a Captain Hammer and got bashing! 

You said the katana was wobbling too much when held with one hand. We agreed! So we reduced the weight of two-handed weapons to make them more fun to handle. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268549/4da97ebbe92b12376f5ddbef58439eca93dfde0b.gif"]

You said Cyclord was the weakest looprunner. We agreed! Now his arrow storm is a true cyclone and his arrows fly faster than ever.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268549/13bf92dbf21376dea087bd12a03b6eeb2fd1db08.gif"]

You said you heard the same lines of dialogue repeatedly when picking up weapons in The Skyscrapper. We agreed! So we put more words into the commentators’ metal mouths.

What do you think? Do you like the feel of two handed weapons now? Are they the right weight? Have you dueled the new and improved Cyclord? Was it a breeze or a hard-fought battle? Are there any other bugs or glitches that frustrate you? 
Leave a comment! We hear you.

Patch Notes:
Buffed Cyclord. Cyclord now spawns more arrows and they fly faster.

Improved Two-Handed Weapons. Reduced the weight of two-handed weapons like the katana, so they don’t wobble as much when used in one hand.

Added Dialogue. Increased the number of lines for the commentators in The Skyscrapper for picking up weapons.

New Turbofist Upgrade. Changed the Air Fist x Arm Extension Fist turbofist upgrade to “Blowback,” which pushes both the player and enemies back.

Assorted Bug Fixes.
Community Fan Art
Phantoma resurrects to tell us something important
[previewyoutube="_htzs-zFMFM;full"][/previewyoutube]

Hic shares exactly what he thinks of Blink's punch ability!

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXedc5pk0ScbBhfqFGKNKdlf5RhXXHsZHZMr8qhbBTFlIF97p2QcFUWfXPNvDFFTXbZdcqH6BmEJpNBkscf96iYkBu2b0dNBR33WUfGNfsVw0Xl00uPui2EouvY3XKnzTuJTKbPZ?key=uf-1lFuFUYHPBZZajY2Sfg"]https://www.reddit.com/r/CloneDrone/comments/1mmsc5t/hyperdome_edition/


PT is drawing bots from memory in our discord, this MX2 is amazing!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268549/9d68d5103f127bcb0c0e7df6abe713b22c4521ea.png"]

Have fun in the Hyperdome!

The Doborog Team

Discord TikTok YouTube

notes.title: The Skyscrapper Update is out now!
notes.notes:
Welcome to The Skyscrapper, Humans!


The new update is out with a ton of new content! We’ve been listening to your feedback to improve the game and one of the biggest things that we heard was that you wanted to play more once the Crashloop was finished! That’s why we added The Skyscrapper, a brand new way to play when you’ve finished the Crashloop story.



Tell us the highest floor you’ve been able to reach in the comments or on our Discord and compete with the rest of the community!


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfPhL0T5V3LatOulWRGu8fvLvl8gqjllf3kqFTKYU8Aocxv8eT3_invw5mZz4gQfDbniQEiJugISTWC7IceZCUZq1DS1nKVNag_CMMkxa1uKeUNTmYUD9zDAxExzarvIgC7PQAdlA?key=I9bZ6mscBmSjsT1Vi18wZg"]

Battle up infinite floors of increasing difficulty! Each level has a different combination of Enemies and theme to keep your experience fresh. The Commentators will watch and make “encouraging” quips with each of your actions.


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdJzgvtsQilIXWFaN8tbyPxTZX88Ngsqh29wAOiuMAI2YJFpyreArqrLNmbDfMTY7CYsfCQJSXMljB3hk0IfBacC6IkL3ADQUrioQ4gshu5Nz9x_aPxNh3B4WZOsgC-5IIVTwkBXA?key=I9bZ6mscBmSjsT1Vi18wZg"][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXebF08U8VTCcgHB4tlYJ5qdISdP9-KID_DtL6oAyoUqRtSi-IY5zjX9f3U67D9ndDXGwYnQuGQJ6vFiEYYh2j32ZdRlr4QmEXeTf14LBBc520_0aEXsrEWaQE73d_6_Bte2_C-4?key=I9bZ6mscBmSjsT1Vi18wZg"]
New Features:
A whole new game mode has opened in Hyperdome: Skyscrapper Mode!

An endless tower of robot destruction! The door to the training room has opened up and revealed a new area. Once you have beaten the Crashloop story mode, the Skyscrapper will rise from the wreckage and give you infinite floors of robot fighting.

The higher you go, the harder it gets!

Earn rewards after each difficulty tier to replace clones or upgrade Turbofists

Each floor has a theme: Swapped weapons! Just Halberd Bots! 10 Captains?!

Fight more than one clone of the same Looprunner!

The commentators keep track of your progress and “encourage” you with unique lines of banter for different milestones. Reach a new personal best? They’ll comment on it. Pick up your favourite weapon? They’ll share their opinions!

What’s the highest floor you can reach?

Cutting Resistance - Change how fast you need to swing to damage enemies!

This is a new setting so you can adapt the difficulty of your battles.

Brains! New green brains have been added to enemy heads. Attacking the head requires the CPU of enemies to be destroyed before they’re defeated.

Two handed weapon handling options

You can now pick how two handed weapons work:

Angle and movement following the top hand

Angle and movement based on position of both hands

New Fire Katana and Fire Halberd weapons!

Enemy AI/behavior improvements:
Enemies have new moves!

The Captain, MX2 and Mark 3 Samurai Bots can riposte. After clashing swords with you, they might try to strike at you while your guard is down.

Enemies will move to block if you aim ranged weapons at them!

Improved enemy jumping animation and behavior.

FLAMEWAR has some new moves!

Overclock activates her Turbofist faster.

Increase the weapon proficiency of some Mark 3 enemies.

Patch Notes and Bug Fixes:
Player hand movement is smoother and has a higher frame rate.

After unlocking all the looprunners, there's 1 fewer easy crawl before the first duel.

Improved sword glow effect.

Faster level loading times.

Improved Arm Extension Turbofist effects.

1 new Crashloop level (Hard difficulty). Lots of bug fixes & minor updates & rebalances to existing Crashloop levels.

Extinguishing fires by waving your hands is now much more effective and responsive.

Rebalances to the amount of coins the player gets and shop prices.

Improved color grading to reduce color banding.

Fixed misoriented colliders on a number of weapons.

Fixed zombies failing to craft in complex environments

Fixed several spots where enemies could get stuck across a number of levels.

Hard levels are even harder

Have fun in The Skyscrapper!
The Doborog Team

Discord TikTok YouTube

notes.title: The Skyscrapper Update: Endless Mode is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello Humans!

For the next update, we are working to address major feedback we have received from the community following the launch:

 The game needs more difficulty options
 There is nothing to do after you conquer the Hyperdome
 The door to the training room leads nowhere???

I will now turn it over to the stars of our next update, who will tell you all about our exciting new game mode…

The Skyscrapper: Infinite Combat in Tower-Form
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268549/c8b6706c922ff8e534017c58a5dfa08b81efc4c3.jpg
Commentatron: Greetings, pathetic humans! 

Analysis-Bot: You are made of skin, blood, and hair, which confuses and infuriates us!!!

Commentatron: We are launching The Skyscrapper, an endless tower and industrial training gym built from Crashloop’s scrapheap.

Analysis-Bot: No human could ever climb this infinitely-tall skyscraper of robot battlefields. They would crawl into a corner to cry and wait for death.

Analysis-Bot: The Skyscrapper is for looprunners only, which is who we are addressing from this point on!!!

Commentatron: After defeating The Captain, you will enter a tube in the loading room. 

Commentatron: Once you are spit out in front of The Skyscrapper, you will beam up to the first floor to brawl with defendroids, looprunner clones, surprise enemies, and terrifyingly new hazards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268549/f52599bf8533f283c96db77764fa3dfeb71c4c04.png
Analysis-Bot: We have the lava and turrets you love, and now the sawblades, crushing walls, and spinning blade traps you soon will crave!!!

Commentatron: What happens when a looprunner climbs to the top of The Skyscrapper?

Analysis-Bot: Error! Trick Question Detected! 

Analysis-Bot: There is no top floor. Combat is infinite. Each floor is tougher than the last. It is gloriously brutal!!!

Commentatron: Excellent analysis. Looprunners will climb as high as possible, endlessly fighting robots, until all their clones are sliced into scrap! How long can you survive The Skyscrapper?

Analysis-Bot: Push your combat skills to the limit and find out.

Commentatron: The best part of The Skyscrapper is… us. Your beloved commentators will be on every floor calling the action play-by-play!

Analysis-Bot: We will provide you with supportive encouragement at every step of the climb.

…

Commentatron: Ha. Ha. Ha.

Analysis-Bot: Ha. Ha. Ha. Can you imagine? 

Analysis-Bot: No! We will be rooting for your painful annihilation.

Commentatron: The Skyscrapper is opening soon. In the meantime, close your eyes and imagine how fun it will be to witness your metal body being sliced in half by a sawblade.

Analysis-Bot: Glorious! Back to you, meat sack game developers!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268549/473350f462bf5ce01fce7f76cd10c0efd375e78e.jpg
Bugs and Quality of Robot Life!

We don’t consider ourselves “meat sacks.” More like skeletons with extra bits. 

Moving on. In parallel to the Skyscrapper work, we're also exploring how to make enemies more interesting and fun.

Don't worry, if you already think the game is hard, the lower level bots won't change in a way that will make it harder for you! We want you to see their attack coming, but still have a chance to die. :)

While we're working on the above two things we've also fixed a ton of bugs and addressed random things that did not feel good.

Physics Smoothing: Hands moved slower than the framerate, but we fixed that!!! All rigidbodies involved in combat now interpolate their state which creates a much smoother feel.
Bloom is prettier: The glow around weapons is now much prettier from all angles. Yay!
Teleporting is better: The player no longer jerks around or gets their weapon stuck in the ground every time they teleport.

We’ll announce a release date in the future once we're confident that the new SkyScrapper Mode is ready for you all to play!

If you'd like to see videos and more frequent progress updates, join us on TikTok, BlueSky or YouTube!
https://www.tiktok.com/@doborog
https://bsky.app/profile/doborog.com
https://www.youtube.com/@doborog

Thanks,
The Doborog Team

notes.title: Wishlist and Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Clone Drone in the Hyperdome
[previewyoutube=Lak9cQqVsrM;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello Humans!

We are very excited to announce that our new game Clone Drone in the Hyperdome is launching on December 12th for Steam for PC VR and Meta Store for Oculus 2 and 3! We hope you enjoy the new trailer!

In Clone Drone in the Hyperdome, sword fight with killer robots in an all-out VR tournament of death! You are Blink, a teleporting robot who is the newest “looprunner” gladiator forced to compete in Crashloop, a deadly roguelike combat sport. Die and reawaken in an endless loop, leap over lava pools, avoid turret fire, take down waves of enemy defendroids, and feel your sword disintegrate their metal bodies. Deal damage exactly where your cut lands using our stunning voxel combat engine! To win your freedom, battle your fellow looprunners for a chance to fight the Captain in the Hyperdome…

Combat Precision & Epic Voxel Destruction The ability to cut robots with swords has never felt better! Players can slice robots arms, legs, and heads off with their sword precisely where they aimed, but they’ll need to be careful because their enemies can do the same to them. 
Incredible Weapon Selection Inside the Crashloop, players can choose from a wide variety of weapons, including broadswords, scythes, axes, and shields. Every looprunner mini-boss has their own unique weapon called a turbofist, which players can acquire by defeating them in duels or triple threat matches. 
Combat Relationships  After a run in the Crashloop, players are sent back to the loading room, where they’ll confront the same looprunners they just battled. The player’s decisions of who they attacked and when will determine their relationships with the other looprunners.
Roguelike Tournament to the Death The player is the newest looprunner in the Crashloop, a deadly combat arena that changes every run through. To win a run in Crashloop, the player must be the last survivor of the tournament, where they battle other looprunners to the death, so they can move on to fight The Captain in the Hyperdome.
All New Gameplay Experience, Fit for VR  The Clone Drone in the Hyperdome experience, building off the success of Doborog’s indie hit Clone Drone in the Danger Zone, brings robot fighting to VR with new content, characters, story and more. The game has been built from the ground up to push what it's possible to do in VR forward, such as implementing physics based sword combat and interactions optimized for the best VR gameplay experience. 

Clone Drone in the Hyperdome is launching on December 12th, 2024 and will be available on the Meta Store for Oculus 2 and 3 and Steam for PC VR.

All the best,
Team Doborog
